item.title: [IGNITE-9084] Trash in WAL after node stop may affect WAL rebalance
item.description:
During iteration over WAL we can face with trash in WAL segment, which can remains after node restart. We should handle this situation in WAL rebalance iterator and gracefully stop iteration process.
